title: Recalibrating the Compass: Integrating Large Language Models into Classical Research Methods

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing and synthesizing empirical studies that use survey-style prompts and persona-free designs to measure directional leaning, ideological skew, and differences in sociopolitical engagement compared to real-world human data.

bias_targets.target: Demographic and Identity bias (e.g., Race, Gender, Age)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating literature on LLM-simulated personas to identify subgroup-level performance discrepancies, stereotype amplification, and the homogenization of diverse within-group opinions among marginalized populations.

Reviewing content analysis and experimental studies to assess how LLMs reflect dominant English-speaking cultural norms and struggle with tasks involving cultural ambiguity or underrepresented minority language communities.

Proposing a three-tier theoretical framework (representational, procedural, and interactional) to diagnose biases introduced by model algorithms, prompt framing, evaluation metrics, and synthetic output sampling procedures.
